WITH latest_week AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_start_date) AS week_start_date
    FROM public.vw_weekly_portfolio_capacity_summary
    WHERE week_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE
),
summary AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM public.vw_weekly_portfolio_capacity_summary
    WHERE week_start_date = (
        SELECT week_start_date FROM latest_week
    )
),
exceptions AS (
    SELECT
        resource_id,
        resource_name,
        role,
        department,
        week_start_date,
        available_hours,
        demand_hours,
        utilization_pct,
        overallocation_hours,
        severity,
        conflict_id,
        conflict_status,
        approval_status,
        governance_status,
        decision_owner,
        decision_date
    FROM public.vw_weekly_capacity_governance
    WHERE week_start_date = (
        SELECT week_start_date FROM latest_week
    )
      AND (
          utilization_pct >= 100
          OR severity IN ('Critical', 'High')
          OR governance_status IN (
              'PENDING_APPROVAL',
              'REJECTED_MITIGATION',
              'CONFLICT_NO_DECISION'
          )
      )
)
SELECT json_build_object(
    'week_start_date', s.week_start_date,
    'portfolio', json_build_object(
        'total_available_capacity_hours', s.total_available_capacity_hours,
        'total_demand_hours', s.total_demand_hours,
        'portfolio_utilization_pct', s.portfolio_utilization_pct,
        'overloaded_resources', s.overloaded_resources,
        'critical_resources', s.critical_resources,
        'pending_approvals', s.pending_approvals,
        'approved_mitigations', s.approved_mitigations,
        'rejected_mitigations', s.rejected_mitigations,
        'conflicts_without_decision', s.conflicts_without_decision
    ),
    'exceptions', COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'resource_id', e.resource_id,
                    'resource_name', e.resource_name,
                    'role', e.role,
                    'department', e.department,
                    'available_hours', e.available_hours,
                    'demand_hours', e.demand_hours,
                    'utilization_pct', e.utilization_pct,
                    'overallocation_hours', e.overallocation_hours,
                    'severity', e.severity,
                    'conflict_id', e.conflict_id,
                    'conflict_status', e.conflict_status,
                    'approval_status', e.approval_status,
                    'governance_status', e.governance_status,
                    'decision_owner', e.decision_owner,
                    'decision_date', e.decision_date
                )
                ORDER BY
                    CASE e.severity
                        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'High' THEN 2
                        WHEN 'Warning' THEN 3
                        ELSE 4
                    END,
                    e.utilization_pct DESC
            )
            FROM exceptions e
        ),
        '[]'::json
    )
) AS dashboard
FROM summary s;

SELECT
    c.conflict_id,
    c.resource_id,
    r.resource_name,
    r.role,
    r.department,
    c.week_start_date,
    c.utilization_pct,
    c.overallocation_hours,
    c.severity,
    c.conflict_type,
    c.status AS conflict_status,
    d.decision_id,
    d.approval_status,
    d.decision,
    d.decision_owner,
    d.decision_date,
    CASE
        WHEN d.decision_id IS NULL THEN 'CONFLICT_NO_DECISION'
        WHEN d.approval_status = 'Pending' THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
        WHEN d.approval_status = 'Approved' THEN 'APPROVED_MITIGATION'
        WHEN d.approval_status = 'Rejected' THEN 'REJECTED_MITIGATION'
        ELSE 'CONFLICT_OPEN'
    END AS governance_status
FROM capacity_conflicts c
JOIN resources r
  ON r.resource_id = c.resource_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        cd.decision_id,
        cd.approval_status,
        cd.decision,
        cd.decision_owner,
        cd.decision_date
    FROM capacity_decisions cd
    WHERE cd.conflict_id = c.conflict_id
    ORDER BY cd.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) d ON true
ORDER BY
    CASE c.severity
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1
        WHEN 'High' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Warning' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END,
    c.utilization_pct DESC;

SELECT
    vr.scenario_id,
    vr.scenario_name,
    cs.scenario_description,

    vr.conflict_id,
    vr.resource_id,
    r.resource_name,
    r.role,
    r.department,
    vr.week_start_date,

    vr.baseline_demand_hours,
    vr.capacity_hours,
    vr.baseline_utilization_pct,

    vr.scenario_demand_hours,
    vr.scenario_utilization_pct,
    vr.scenario_outcome,

    vr.effectiveness_score,
    vr.governance_score,
    vr.overall_recommendation_score,
    vr.recommendation_rank,

    cs.critical_path_impact,
    cs.priority_impact,
    cs.creates_secondary_conflict,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'project_id', sa.project_id,
                    'resource_id', sa.resource_id,
                    'activity_name', sa.activity_name,
                    'original_week_start_date', sa.original_week_start_date,
                    'proposed_week_start_date', sa.proposed_week_start_date,
                    'original_hours', sa.original_hours,
                    'proposed_hours', sa.proposed_hours,
                    'change_type', sa.change_type
                )
                ORDER BY sa.scenario_allocation_id
            )
            FROM scenario_allocations sa
            WHERE sa.scenario_id = vr.scenario_id
        ),
        '[]'::json
    ) AS proposed_changes

FROM vw_scenario_recommendations vr

JOIN capacity_scenarios cs
  ON cs.scenario_id = vr.scenario_id

JOIN resources r
  ON r.resource_id = vr.resource_id

ORDER BY
    vr.conflict_id,
    vr.recommendation_rank;

parameters.jsCode:
const payload = $json.payload;

const project = {
  project_id:
    payload.project.project_id.trim().toUpperCase(),

  project_name:
    payload.project.project_name.trim(),

  priority:
    payload.project.priority,

  status:
    payload.project.status || 'Active',

  start_date:
    payload.project.start_date,

  end_date:
    payload.project.end_date
};

const resource = {
  resource_id:
    payload.resource.resource_id.trim().toUpperCase(),

  resource_name:
    payload.resource.resource_name.trim(),

  role:
    payload.resource.role.trim(),

  department:
    payload.resource.department.trim(),

  standard_weekly_hours:
    Number(payload.resource.standard_weekly_hours),

  active:
    payload.resource.active !== false
};

const capacity = {
  resource_id:
    resource.resource_id,

  week_start_date:
    payload.capacity.week_start_date,

  standard_hours:
    Number(payload.capacity.standard_hours),

  leave_hours:
    Number(payload.capacity.leave_hours || 0),

  holiday_hours:
    Number(payload.capacity.holiday_hours || 0),

  training_hours:
    Number(payload.capacity.training_hours || 0),

  bau_hours:
    Number(payload.capacity.bau_hours || 0)
};

const demand = payload.demand.map(
  (d, index) => ({
    demand_sequence:
      index + 1,

    resource_id:
      resource.resource_id,

    project_id:
      d.project_id.trim().toUpperCase(),

    week_start_date:
      payload.capacity.week_start_date,

    activity_name:
      d.activity_name.trim(),

    planned_hours:
      Number(d.planned_hours),

    priority:
      d.priority,

    critical_path:
      Boolean(d.critical_path)
  })
);

return {
  json: {
    intake_status: 'NORMALIZED',
    project,
    resource,
    capacity,
    demand,
    demand_count: demand.length
  }
};

INSERT INTO projects (
    project_id,
    project_name,
    priority,
    status,
    start_date,
    end_date
)
VALUES (
    $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6
)
ON CONFLICT (project_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    project_name = EXCLUDED.project_name,
    priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    start_date = EXCLUDED.start_date,
    end_date = EXCLUDED.end_date
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO resource_demand (
    resource_id,
    project_id,
    week_start_date,
    activity_name,
    planned_hours,
    activity_priority,
    critical_path
)
VALUES (
    $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7
)
ON CONFLICT (
    resource_id,
    project_id,
    week_start_date,
    activity_name
)
DO UPDATE SET
    planned_hours =
        EXCLUDED.planned_hours,

    activity_priority =
        EXCLUDED.activity_priority,

    critical_path =
        EXCLUDED.critical_path,

    updated_at =
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING *;

WITH utilization AS (
    SELECT
        rc.resource_id,
        rc.week_start_date,
        rc.available_hours,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(rd.planned_hours),
            0
        ) AS demand_hours,

        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN rc.available_hours > 0
                THEN (
                    COALESCE(
                        SUM(rd.planned_hours),
                        0
                    )
                    / rc.available_hours
                ) * 100
                ELSE 0
            END,
            2
        ) AS utilization_pct,

        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(rd.planned_hours),
                0
            ) - rc.available_hours,
            0
        ) AS overallocation_hours

    FROM resource_capacity rc

    LEFT JOIN resource_demand rd
      ON rd.resource_id = rc.resource_id
     AND rd.week_start_date =
         rc.week_start_date

    WHERE rc.resource_id = $1
      AND rc.week_start_date = $2

    GROUP BY
        rc.resource_id,
        rc.week_start_date,
        rc.available_hours
),

classified AS (
    SELECT
        u.*,

        CASE
            WHEN u.utilization_pct >= 120
                THEN 'Critical'

            WHEN u.utilization_pct >= 100
                THEN 'High'

            WHEN u.utilization_pct >= 85
                THEN 'Warning'

            ELSE 'Normal'
        END AS severity

    FROM utilization u
)

INSERT INTO capacity_conflicts (
    resource_id,
    week_start_date,
    conflict_type,
    utilization_pct,
    overallocation_hours,
    severity,
    status
)

SELECT
    resource_id,
    week_start_date,
    'RESOURCE_OVERALLOCATION',
    utilization_pct,
    overallocation_hours,
    severity,
    'Open'

FROM classified

WHERE utilization_pct >= 100

ON CONFLICT (
    resource_id,
    week_start_date,
    conflict_type
)

DO UPDATE SET
    utilization_pct =
        EXCLUDED.utilization_pct,

    overallocation_hours =
        EXCLUDED.overallocation_hours,

    severity =
        EXCLUDED.severity,

    status =
        'Open'

RETURNING *;

WITH latest_decisions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (cd.conflict_id)
        cd.conflict_id,
        cd.decision_id,
        cd.approval_status,
        cd.decision,
        cd.decision_owner,
        cd.decision_date,
        cd.created_at
    FROM capacity_decisions cd
    ORDER BY
        cd.conflict_id,
        cd.created_at DESC
),

audit_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT decision_id) FILTER (
            WHERE action = 'RECOMMENDATION_CREATED'
        ) AS recommendations_created,

        COUNT(DISTINCT decision_id) FILTER (
            WHERE action = 'DECISION_APPROVED'
        ) AS decisions_approved,

        COUNT(DISTINCT decision_id) FILTER (
            WHERE action = 'DECISION_REJECTED'
        ) AS decisions_rejected,

        COUNT(DISTINCT decision_id) AS decisions_touched,

        COUNT(DISTINCT conflict_id) AS conflicts_touched,

        COUNT(*) AS governance_events
    FROM capacity_decision_audit
),

recent_audit AS (
    SELECT
        a.audit_id,
        a.decision_id,
        a.conflict_id,
        a.previous_status,
        a.new_status,
        a.action,
        a.action_by,
        a.action_source,
        a.action_timestamp,
        a.notes
    FROM capacity_decision_audit a
    ORDER BY a.action_timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 25
)

SELECT json_build_object(
    'summary',
        (
            SELECT json_build_object(
                'recommendations_created', recommendations_created,
                'decisions_approved', decisions_approved,
                'decisions_rejected', decisions_rejected,
                'decisions_touched', decisions_touched,
                'conflicts_touched', conflicts_touched,
                'governance_events', governance_events
            )
            FROM audit_summary
        ),

    'decisions',
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT json_agg(
                    json_build_object(
                        'conflict_id', ld.conflict_id,
                        'decision_id', ld.decision_id,
                        'approval_status', ld.approval_status,
                        'decision', ld.decision,
                        'decision_owner', ld.decision_owner,
                        'decision_date', ld.decision_date,
                        'created_at', ld.created_at
                    )
                    ORDER BY ld.conflict_id
                )
                FROM latest_decisions ld
            ),
            '[]'::json
        ),

    'audit',
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT json_agg(
                    json_build_object(
                        'audit_id', ra.audit_id,
                        'decision_id', ra.decision_id,
                        'conflict_id', ra.conflict_id,
                        'previous_status', ra.previous_status,
                        'new_status', ra.new_status,
                        'action', ra.action,
                        'action_by', ra.action_by,
                        'action_source', ra.action_source,
                        'action_timestamp', ra.action_timestamp,
                        'notes', ra.notes
                    )
                )
                FROM recent_audit ra
            ),
            '[]'::json
        )
) AS governance;

SELECT json_build_object(
    'reports',
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'report_id', r.report_id,
                    'report_week_start', r.report_week_start,
                    'report_week_end', r.report_week_end,
                    'generated_at', r.generated_at,
                    'total_available_capacity_hours', r.total_available_capacity_hours,
                    'total_demand_hours', r.total_demand_hours,
                    'portfolio_utilization_pct', r.portfolio_utilization_pct,
                    'overloaded_resources', r.overloaded_resources,
                    'critical_resources', r.critical_resources,
                    'recommendations_created', r.recommendations_created,
                    'decisions_approved', r.decisions_approved,
                    'decisions_rejected', r.decisions_rejected,
                    'pending_approvals', r.pending_approvals,
                    'conflicts_without_decision', r.conflicts_without_decision,
                    'report_status', r.report_status,
                    'exceptions',
                    COALESCE(
                        (
                            SELECT json_agg(
                                json_build_object(
                                    'report_exception_id', e.report_exception_id,
                                    'resource_id', e.resource_id,
                                    'conflict_id', e.conflict_id,
                                    'utilization_pct', e.utilization_pct,
                                    'overallocation_hours', e.overallocation_hours,
                                    'severity', e.severity,
                                    'governance_status', e.governance_status,
                                    'decision_status', e.decision_status
                                )
                                ORDER BY e.utilization_pct DESC
                            )
                            FROM weekly_capacity_report_exceptions e
                            WHERE e.report_id = r.report_id
                        ),
                        '[]'::json
                    )
                )
                ORDER BY r.generated_at DESC
            )
            FROM weekly_capacity_reports r
        ),
        '[]'::json
    )
) AS weekly_reports;
